summary: Completed testing of WebSocket notifications and NotificationBell integration. Fixed 1 bug in notification endpoints (current_user.id -> current_user['id']). All 13 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified - NotificationBell displays correctly in TeacherDashboard with WebSocket status indicator.

fixed.issue: Notification endpoints used current_user.id (attribute access) but get_current_user returns dict - caused 500 errors

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connection times out through Kubernetes ingress (wss://academiapro-13.preview.emergentagent.com). Works locally on ws://localhost:8001
integration_issues.notes: This is an infrastructure limitation, not a code issue. WebSocket works correctly when tested locally.

critical_code_review_comments: websocket_manager.py is well-structured with proper connection management and cleanup
NotificationBell.js has good WebSocket reconnection logic with 5-second retry
Real-time notifications are sent via ws_manager.send_personal_notification() when Q/R answers are posted
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed notification endpoints to use dict access (current_user['id']) instead of attribute access (current_user.id)
/app/backend/tests/test_websocket_notifications.py - Created comprehensive test suite for WebSocket features
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebSocket notifications are implemented and working. The /ws/notifications/{user_id} endpoint accepts connections and responds to ping/pong. NotificationBell component is integrated in both StudentDashboard and TeacherDashboard with WebSocket status indicator (green=connected, red=disconnected). Real-time notifications are sent when teachers answer student questions via ws_manager.send_personal_notification().

teacher_dashboard.notification_bell: Visible in header with bell icon, badge count, and WebSocket status indicator
teacher_dashboard.notification_popover: Opens correctly showing notifications list or 'Aucune notification' message

websocket_local_test.result: SUCCESS - Connected and received pong response
